decision: Choose homogeneous-only calibration because both development protocols decoded every trial; this more stringent scheme exposes no mixed word order during calibration. Keep original preprocessing and prompt.
confirmation: All 62 eligible mixed-sequence trials in chronological second half; two independent identical-prompt calls, within-word-bag shuffled recordings and no-signal control.
new_hypothesis: Reused word patterns plus timing adaptation support ordered unseen combinations; generic slot baselines may fail because timing is variable. Add temporal sequence baselines before claiming advantage.
